norm_matched.note: Norm-matched comparison (wide net at an alpha whose norm at fit equals the narrow net's) is not achievable with alpha: the norm at t_fit (first logged step >= t_fit, 250-500 steps) is measured after 250-500 optimiser steps, and alpha does not set it cleanly: at w=32 it is 34.0/32.6/34.8 for alpha 0.5/1/2 (non-monotone, within 7%), at w=128 39.1/42.8/48.3. The lowest norm at fit at w=128 (alpha 0.5, 39.1) still exceeds w=32 alpha=1 (32.6), so no alpha in the run grid matches them; alpha<0.5 was not run (budget). The alpha effect on t_gen is therefore reported as a total effect of init scale, not as an effect through norm at fit.
